items.html: And the nose is numerically equal to Samech-Gimel [63]; and the matter is that even though it came out of the third head, which is the name MA of Alpin, while Samech-Gimel is above it, in the second head, nevertheless the matter is that it is true that the nose is in the third head, but it is numerically equal to Samech-Gimel, to hint that from there is drawn the Samech-Gimel which is in the second head, which is above it, and from there it came out to the third head.
